result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, and nothing has been type-checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with `{ body }`. `useUpdateComment` refetches the comments list after saving and shows a "Comment Updated" success notification.
- **UI:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer, prefilled with the current body. I wired it into `comments-list.tsx` next to the Delete button.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that allows only the comment's author, with no admin override. Delete still lets admins through.
- **Mock API:** `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` has a `PATCH` handler that updates a comment only if the current user is its author.

The lint hook flagged `useNotifications` in my first version of the component, since feature components aren't allowed to call it. I moved the notification into the `useUpdateComment` hook. The existing create and delete comment components still call it directly. I left those alone.
